title: Mandatory contribution and PR evidence policy
scope: Shared agent instructions, PR contract CI, admin ruleset checklist and non-bypass governance

criteria.when: It lacks acceptance IDs or matching record

criteria.given: A PR has a malformed or falsely ACCEPTED record
An agent or human tries to directly push to main
criteria.then: GitHub rejects direct writes and requires reviewed PR

criteria.given: A PR has pending/failed checks or no independent approval

blockers: Repository ruleset not configured or not verifiable from current connector permissions
No independent reviewer acceptance of exact SHA/environment
